jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.boun: §6Ritual of Boundless Skies§r: Place Ancient Debris on top. Costs 10000 EV. Grants 15 minutes of creative flight.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.enha: §6Ritual of Enhancement§r: Place an Amethyst Block on top. Costs 5000 EV. Enhances all enchantments on mainhand item by 1 level. Cannot enhance already enhanced items.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.hung: §6Ritual of Hunger§r: Place a Bone Block on top. Costs 500 EV. Makes you very hungry.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.info: Reusable ritual stone. Place a block on top and right-click to activate the ritual effect. Each use costs EV but the stone is not consumed.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.iron: §6Ritual of the Iron Heart§r: Place an Arcane Anvil on top. Costs 3500 EV. Grants Echoing Strikes III for 15 minutes. Requires Iron's Spellbooks.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.magi: §6Ritual of the Magi§r: Place a Source Gem Block on top. Costs 2500 EV. Grants Mana Regen for 15 minutes. Requires Ars Nouveau.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.mana: §6Ritual of the Manasteel Soul§r: Place a Manasteel Block on top. Costs 2500 EV. Grants Emptiness and Speed for 15 minutes. Requires Botania.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.nept: §6Ritual of Neptune's Blessing§r: Place a Prismarine Block on top. Costs 2000 EV. Grants Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 15 minutes.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.redu: §6Ritual of Reduction§r: Place a Bookshelf on top. Costs 1000 EV. Removes enhanced mark and downgrades all enchantments by 1 level (minimum level 1).
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.regr: §6Ritual of Regression§r: Place a Bookshelf on top. Costs 3000 EV. Removes repair cost from held item.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.soul: §6Ritual of the Soul Stained Blood§r: Place a Block of Hallowed Gold on top. Costs 2000 EV. Grants Gaia's Bulwark for 15 minutes. Requires Malum.
jei.animusnv.imperfect_ritual_stone.ward: §6Ritual of the Warden§r: Place a Sculk Block on top. Costs 3000 EV. Grants Obsidian Cloak for 15 minutes.

jei.animusnv.sanguine_scroll.info:
Sanguine Scrolls are reusable spell scrolls powered by Essentia Vitae instead of mana.

§6Crafting:§r Right-click an Ara Vitae while holding an Iron's Spellbooks scroll in your main hand and a NeoVitae slate in your offhand. The altar consumes EV based on spell rarity and level.

§6Usage:§r Right-click to cast the stored spell, consuming EV from your Anima. Each use damages the scroll's durability.
